verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a consumer graphics card, not a web service, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec for an HTTP API is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Its software surface is the ROCm stack of native libraries, not a network API. The probe found no OpenAPI file at the docs domain, and nothing in the evidence shows AMD shipping a machine-readable API spec that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
